title: The Fall of Nineveh and the Downfall of the Lion
description: A powerful prophetic account of how the Lord restores the glory of Jacob and Israel while destroying Nineveh. Chariots rage through the streets like flaming torches, the gates of the rivers open, and the palace melts away. The city is plundered for silver and gold, and the lion's den—symbol of Assyrian power—is left empty. Finally, the Lord, God of Hosts, speaks: He comes against Nineveh; the sword will devour the lion cubs, and the voice of messengers will never be heard again.
